g.text: GIRO duty 13309 · five places, three charging sites
Recorded schedule · same approximate layout in both panels · depot displaced for clarity · 22 passenger trips
L = passenger-leg order, not Trip ID · M = inter-area empty-move order · orange rings identify charging sites
The editable itinerary preserves all trip clocks, numbered visits, platform movements, waits and preparation. This is not a newly optimized schedule.
Approximate layout, not road paths; depot displaced for clarity. Stop-area proxies © OpenStreetMap contributors; actual coordinates retained in CSV.
